verdict.rationale: Idempotent retries are a fair question for a transactional email send API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers send methods (SDK, SMTP, API v2 Simple/Raw/Templated), event publishing and sandbox rules, but none of it mentions idempotency keys, client tokens or duplicate-suppression semantics for retried sends.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can retry a failed send safely — idempotency keys or documented duplicate-suppression semantics guarantee a network timeout never double-sends a receipt
